title: "Eraser Tool Options Widget"
format: html
---

## Overview

`EraserToolOptions_Widget` is the options-bar page shown when `MediaToolId::Eraser` is active in the Media Viewer left tool strip. It configures the hover-circle radius used for brush-style erasing on lines and masks.

## Controls

| Control | State field | Description |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| Eraser size slider / spinbox | `EraserToolPrefs::radius_px` | Hover circle radius in scene pixels (1–50, default 10) |

## Behavior

When the Eraser tool is active:

- **Lines:** left-click drag on a selected line removes all vertices within the hover circle. Remaining vertices stay connected in order (for example, erasing vertices 13–15 leaves vertex 12 adjacent to vertex 16).
- **Masks:** left-click drag removes mask pixels under the hover circle, replacing the former mask brush right-click erase path.

`Media_Widget::_syncEraserHoverCircle()` enables the shared `Media_Window` hover circle and applies `EraserToolPrefs::radius_px`.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaLine_Widget::_erasePointsFromLine` | Removes line vertices within radius |
| `MediaMask_Widget::_removeFromMask` | Removes mask pixels within brush ellipse |
| `Media_Window::setShowHoverCircle` / `setHoverCircleRadius` | Shared hover-circle rendering |

See also [Media Viewer Tool Strip](MediaToolStrip.qmd) and [Media Viewer Tool Options Bar](MediaToolOptionsBar.qmd).
